sed -n 49,58p crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs; rg -n "introspection::|INTROSPECTION_PROSE" crates/athena-data/src/records.rs | head; rg -n "fn sample_introspection|introspections_of_the_three_old" crates/athena-data/src/records.rs
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core introspect 2>&1 | tail -30; cargo test -p athena-data 2>&1 | grep -E "test result|FAILED|failed|error" | head
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core introspect 2>&1 | rg "test result|FAILED|failed|error|panicked" ; cargo test -p athena-data 2>&1 | rg "test result|FAILED|failed|error"

cargo fmt --all && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tail -n 20; cargo test --locked 2>&1 | grep -E "^test result|FAILED|failed|panicked|error" | head -40
cargo fmt --all && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1; cargo test --locked 2>&1 | grep -E "^test result|FAILED|failed|panicked|^error" | head -40
cargo test -p xtask --test policy 2>&1 | tail -n 5; echo done
cargo test -p xtask --test policy && cargo test -p athena-core introspect 2>&1 | head -n 3
